cohort: 7074 mother-offspring pairs at age 3, decreasing to 4071 pairs at age 16, from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) in the United Kingdom
finding: Mode of delivery does not appear to be associated with emotional and behavioural problems in children and adolescents.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of emotional problems at age 11 years, but no associations were found between caesarean delivery and emotional and behavioural measures at any age.
